ask.trust.title: May the agent work with the files in this folder?
ask.trust.detail: The agent will be able to read, change and run files in its workspace folder. Allow it if this is your folder or you trust it.
ask.plan.title: The agent has made a plan. Start now?
ask.plan.detail: The agent has been thinking and planning without changing anything. Now it asks whether to start and how to check changes with you.
ask.submit.title: Send your answers to the agent?
ask.submit.detail: You have answered the agent's questions. Check and send them — the agent will continue.
ask.edit.title: The agent wants to change a document
ask.edit.detail: The agent has prepared a change to a document in its workspace and waits for your approval. If unsure, tap «No» and write what to do instead.
ask.create.title: The agent wants to create a new document
ask.create.detail: The agent wants to save a new document in its workspace and waits for your approval.
ask.overwrite.title: The agent wants to overwrite a document
ask.overwrite.detail: The old content of the document will be replaced. Allow it if you expected this.
ask.fetch.title: The agent wants to open a web page
ask.fetch.detail: The agent will read a web page to find information. It does not change anything on the site.
ask.search.title: The agent wants to search the web
ask.search.detail: The agent will search the web for your task and read the results.
ask.mcp.title: The agent wants to use a connected service
ask.mcp.detail: The agent will use a service you connected (mail, calendar, spreadsheets and so on). Allow it if the task needs it.
ask.bash.title: The agent wants to run an action on the computer
ask.bash.detail: This is a command for the computer the agent runs on: for example, to calculate, build or delete files. If you did not expect it, tap «No».
ask.read.title: The agent wants to read a document outside its folder
ask.read.detail: The agent needs a document outside its workspace. Allow it only if this is your document and the task needs it.
ask.notebook.title: The agent wants to change a notebook
ask.notebook.detail: The agent has prepared a change to a calculation notebook and waits for your approval.
ask.proceed.title: The agent asks permission to continue
ask.proceed.detail: The agent needs your consent for the next step. If unsure, tap «No»: the agent will stop and ask what to do.
ask.question.title: The agent has a question
ask.question.detail: Pick an answer. If none fits, tap «Your own answer» and write it.
ask.continue.title: The agent is waiting for you to continue
ask.continue.detail: Tap «Continue» so the agent gets back to work.
ask.unknown.title: The agent is asking for permission
ask.unknown.detail: The agent is waiting for your decision, but the panel cannot retell this question yet. «Allow» agrees to the first option. «Don't allow» declines: the agent will stop and ask what to do.
opt.yes.label: Yes
opt.yes.note: Allow once — the agent will ask again next time.
opt.yes-proceed.label: Yes, continue
opt.trust-yes.label: Yes, I trust this folder
opt.trust-yes.note: The agent will start working in this folder.
opt.yes-session.label: Yes, and don't ask until the work is done
opt.yes-session.note: Until the end of this conversation the agent will do the same action without asking.
opt.yes-always.label: Yes, and don't ask about this again
opt.yes-always.note: The agent will remember the permission for this folder and will do such actions without asking. Choose only if you are sure.
opt.yes-domain.label: Yes, and always allow this site
opt.yes-domain.note: The agent will open pages of this site without asking.
opt.yes-all-edits.label: Yes, and allow all changes until the work is done
opt.yes-all-edits.note: The agent will change and create documents without asking until the end of this conversation. Choose only if you are sure.
opt.yes-read-dir.label: Yes, and allow reading this folder
opt.yes-read-dir.note: Until the work is done the agent may read documents in this folder without asking.
opt.plan-bypass.label: Yes, and don't ask anything
opt.plan-bypass.note: The agent will carry out the whole plan without a single question. Risky: choose only if you fully trust the plan.
opt.plan-auto.label: Yes, and make changes without asking
opt.plan-auto.note: The agent will change documents according to the plan without asking about each change.
opt.plan-manual.label: Yes, but ask before changes
opt.plan-manual.note: The agent will start and ask you before each change.
opt.plan-keep.label: No, keep planning
opt.plan-keep.note: The agent will keep working on the plan.
opt.plan-change.label: Change the plan
opt.plan-change.note: Write to the agent what to change in the plan.
opt.no-tell.label: No
opt.no-tell.note: The agent will not do this. Write to it what to do instead.
opt.no-exit.label: No, exit
opt.no-exit.note: The agent will not start in this folder.
opt.no.label: No
opt.submit.label: Send answers
opt.submit.note: Send your answers to the agent.
opt.cancel.label: Cancel
opt.cancel.note: Do not answer the agent's questions.
opt.type.label: Your own answer
opt.type.note: Write your answer in the field below.
opt.other.label: Other
opt.other.note: Write your answer in the field below.
opt.chat.label: Discuss with the agent
opt.chat.note: Write to the agent what is unclear — it will explain.
opt.yes-other.label: Yes, with a wider permission
opt.yes-other.note: A permission wider than once. Choose only if you are sure.
opt.allow.label: Allow
opt.deny.label: Don't allow
opt.details.label: Show details
opt.continue.label: Continue

err.auth: The agent needs to sign in again — contact the panel owner.
err.network: No connection to the model service. The agent will retry; if it fails, write again.
err.context: The conversation has become too long. The agent will shorten it, or start a new conversation.
err.interrupted: The agent has been stopped. Write what to do next.
err.api: The model service returned an error. Try writing again.
status.queued: Finishing the previous task — your message is next
status.stuck: The agent is not responding yet
